steps.name: Black Market Merchant
steps.text: Hey, come check this out. We got ourselves a new lackey! You, stop lazing around. Go!

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: I'm the new craftsman apprentice. My name's El—

steps.name: Black Market Merchant
steps.text: Alright, enough talk. Get moving!

steps.name: Black Market Merchant
steps.text: Hey, you lot! Use him however you want. He's apparently one of those bookworm types from Columbia, even younger than your kids!

steps.name: Black Market Merchant
steps.text: Just treat him like those slaves that got sold to us. As long as it doesn't kill him, that is. It's not like he's got a guardian angel watching his back.

steps.name: Black Market Merchant
steps.text: We'll work you to bone, kid.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Isin, look!

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Oh... What a surprise. Did you weld this together with the steel you stole? What a magnificent piece.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: You're exaggerating. It doesn't matter how pretty it is; it's just consumables.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: But you must rest. Your broken arm has only just healed...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Don't worry.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Do you know where we can get some refined Originium?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: There is nothing that gold cannot buy in the Reefsteep Black Market.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Let's see how this turns out, then...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: The black scorpion is dead...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: We've done well, haven't we?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Old Isin heard from the fence today... The 'Sand Soldier' is the next ruler of Reefsteep.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Do you think you are? Elliot?

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: And do you wish me to be, Isin?

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: I'm not one to forget the kindness others have shown me. If it wasn't for you, I would not have survived these past two decades.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Now you need Old Isin no more...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: No... Hardly. We have a special relationship, after all.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: But if you wanted to complain, perhaps you should complain to that lady who cloaked herself in all those mysteries.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: You still remember her name. You've gotten less and less clear-headed over the years. I thought you'd have forgotten that, among many other things.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Have you looked for her?

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: Yes, I have, but my attempts have been futile. Not even my most elite intelligence agents could find any information about her in Columbia. Besides, the PMC disbanded not long after that.

steps.name: Elliot
steps.text: The laboratory was taken over by the military, and all of their data were destroyed. I could not find even a single participant... Columbia hid them well.

steps.name: 'Sand Soldier'
steps.text: The Ibuti Lord Ameer will pass through Redhorn next week. Hoh, fate can be a fickle mistress sometimes.

steps.name: 'Sand Soldier'
steps.text: This is an excellent opportunity—Old Isin, are you asleep?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Old Isin had a dream...

steps.name: 'Sand Soldier'
steps.text: Another one of your dreams?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: It was still the same dream as always... The Kheshig's footsteps went across the tundra and grasslands, at last reaching the land of golden sands.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: But, this time, the dream was a little different...

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: It was a scenery that the padishah never recounted to Old Isin... There was someone there... She looked like... like Kal'tsit... in another form.

steps.name: 'Sand Soldier'
steps.text: Hm.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: She was there.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: When the Kheshigs' conquest shattered that bygone era all those thousands of years ago... she was there...

steps.name: 'Sand Soldier'
steps.text: Dreams can't explain much, and there are no Arts that allow us to glimpse into our fate across time. You said so yourself.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Yes... This is merely a dream that Old Isin had... a meaningless dream... Lady Kal'tsit could not have had anything to do with them... but it does make Old Isin wonder if there is meaning to this dream.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: At the very end, Old Isin saw the padishah.

steps.name: 'Sand Soldier'
steps.text: Oh? And what did your master tell you this time, old faithful?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: He...

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: In my dream... he told Old Isin... where Sargon is...

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: You are planning to ambush the lord ameer's squadron.

steps.name: 'Sand Soldier'
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: 'Sand Soldier'
steps.text: So you mean to tell me that you, a former faithful aide to a Sargon noble, will stop me from disrespecting a lord ameer so?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: —Disrespect?

steps.name: 'Sand Soldier'
steps.text: Hm.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: They are rotten and incompetent. They only know to bootlessly harm their kin and drag innocent Sargonians into war...

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: They stand on Reefsteep's land, doing their dirty work. Why would Old Isin feel respect for men like them?

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Old Isin wants them to pay the price. Old Isin wants the glory of Sargon's past be restored, and not by these good-for-nothing clowns!

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Old Isin... Right... Old Isin must seek the city of golden sands!

steps.name: 'Sand Soldier'
steps.text: I don't see you get this excited often. Please, calm down—

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: It's time...

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Go, my child. Light a fire, and complete your revenge.

steps.name: Old Isin
steps.text: Until the time comes when the winds finally calm and the eternal city rises from the sandstorm... Old Isin will wait... and Old Isin will reach that place...

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: This is the place...

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Be sure to knock first.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Don't get any funny ideas. The elite operators here ain't no pushovers.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Now go.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Looks like that gold coin made it to you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: How is Old Isin?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: He's lost to the golden sands... It happened one moonlit night three years ago.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Time. Time can put to rest even a Savra like him. I almost thought him to be one of the ancient, elder beings in folk tales and conspiracy theories.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Time has warped me so much, transforming me into a man my past self would have hated.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: And you, Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: It looks like... nothing about you has changed.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Are you still the 'Sand Soldier?'

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: I already said this when I came onboard. That is all in the past. I have a new name now.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You can fool yourself... but you can't fool me.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Perhaps. You've always thought everything you said was absolute, and unfortunately for me, you were quite often right.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You have always had a good memory, Elliot.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Don't call me by that name... Don't we have these codenames exactly for this purpose, to shroud our secrets?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit—Oh, my apologies. Do you have a visitor?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No matter.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Please, as you were.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: A Messenger from the field office in Victoria sent us a package. It's pretty strange, too. It's not addressed to Rhodes Island, but you personally. Logistics has already scanned the package. There's an information storage device inside.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: The sender's name is... Heidi Thomson. Do you know her?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This is just some intel I needed. Leave it there.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Okay... that is all.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: A new conspiracy, I presume?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Watch your mouth. You may not officially be an operator here yet, but you signed a contract.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Exactly what I expected our 'Operations Adviser' to say.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Kal'tsit, you pointed Old Isin to a new direction, and for that he was forever grateful up until the moment he set out on his journey again.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: I cannot begin to imagine the glory you two shared, but now that my business in Sargon has been taken care of, there is nothing that binds me to this world anymore...

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: I suppose you will point me in a new direction as well?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Before that... Let me introduce you to someone.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Here I thought you would keep me close to you. Did you get me a partner?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Your commanding officer.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: A Rhodes Island commander? You... Hoh... There is someone whom you trust so deeply here? I look forward to meeting this person, then.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: You wandered the world for so long. How long will you stay here this time?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You have no right to ask.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Very well, of course. You needn't answer if you don't want to, as you are now my superior.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: But if this is yet another false identity, and this place where you belong is yet again false, then I am afraid it would hardly be meaningful for me to serve this place.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: How am I to tell you are not using me yet again?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You have the right to be suspicious...

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: I need only a little assurance. Will this 'Kal'tsit' who invited me here disappear all of a sudden in a few days, a few months, or perhaps a few years?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Will she again set off on a journey to take care of some business that a bystander could never come to understand, to drift the world for her own purposes?

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Will you?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If a simple answer can affect your loyalty to Rhodes Island, then perhaps I must reevaluate this working relationship of ours.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: I only need an answer. An answer should not be so hard for you. I'll even accept a lie.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If it is answers that you want, I have thousands of them.

steps.name: Passenger
steps.text: Then, please, pick any one of them.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, here you are.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Closure has finished resupplying, but there seems to be an emergency there that needs your attention. Amiya is heading there already.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Don't keep her waiting. She has been working very hard, and you should be there at her side when she needs you the most.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Of course... That goes for you as well.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Don't push yourself too hard. Rhodes Island needs you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I have an unexpected consultation to attend to in a moment, so I will leave it to you and Amiya to wrap things up.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If things go well, perhaps we will get to announce to the whole ship before sundown—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —Time to set sail.
